stories.title: Houthi strike damage at Ras Tanura
stories.what: Satellite imagery has confirmed that a Houthi missile strike on the Saudi oil export hub of Ras Tanura hit a critical component of the complex.
stories.why_it_matters: Ras Tanura is a major crude loading point; damage there affects crude availability and risk premiums for tankers loading in the Arabian Gulf, and sits alongside today's exceptionally high VLCC earnings.
stories.latest: Damage confirmed via commercially-available satellite imaging.
sources: Strike Damage Confirmed at Giant Saudi Refinery Complex

stories.title: US Iran blockade warnings and vessel blacklist
stories.what: US forces have reiterated blockade warnings to shipping, with the PGSA blacklist expanding to 125 vessels, alongside a piracy warning for the Gulf of Aden.
stories.why_it_matters: A growing blacklist shrinks the compliant tanker pool and raises war-risk and routing costs through Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab, which feeds directly into crude and product tanker earnings.
stories.latest: Blacklist reported at 125 vessels; Gulf of Aden piracy warning issued.
sources: Gulf of Aden piracy warning as US issues Iran blockade update

stories.title: Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab VLCC transits
stories.what: Hormuz recorded six VLCC transits on Oct 25, the most since Oct 17, while Bab al-Mandab recorded one VLCC on each of Oct 24 and Oct 25.
stories.why_it_matters: Chokepoint transit counts are a direct read on whether crude tankers are routing through or around high-risk waters, which changes voyage lengths and tonne-mile demand.
stories.latest: Hormuz transits climbed; Bab al-Mandab steady for a second day.
sources: VLCC transits climb at Hormuz; steady at Bab al-Mandab for second day

stories.title: Russian diesel returning across the Atlantic
stories.what: A reported US-Russia agreement on diesel exports across the Atlantic is said to be creating a new trade, while a US senator is demanding a tanker carrying Russian diesel to the US reverse course amid a legal fight.
stories.why_it_matters: A reopened Atlantic diesel route would reshape clean product tanker ton-miles and MR and LR employment patterns, but the legal challenge leaves delivery uncertain.
stories.latest: Senator Blumenthal demanded the tanker turn around, warning the owner that delivering the cargo would violate federal law.
sources: Russian Diesel Returns: A New Atlantic Trade Dynamic
U.S. Senator Demands Russian Diesel Tanker Turn Around as Legal Fight Escalates

stories.title: Boluda to acquire Samskip
stories.what: Boluda Shipping has signed an agreement to acquire Samskip, intended to create a short-sea network linking Northern Europe, Iberia, the Canaries and West Africa.
stories.why_it_matters: Consolidation of European short-sea operators changes who controls regional feeder and container capacity and the trades it serves.
stories.latest: Acquisition announced 28 October; both companies framed it as building a comprehensive short-sea network.
sources: Boluda Shipping to Acquire Samskip, Expanding Europe’s Short-Sea Network
Boluda Shipping’s acquisition of Samskip aimed at strengthening its European short-sea network and building connections with West Africa
